sections.name: Part A: Reasoning Ability, Logic & Computer Literacy (विवेचना एवं तार्किक योग्यता तथा कंप्यूटर ज्ञान)
Part B: General Knowledge, General Science, Social Science & Current Affairs (सामान्य ज्ञान, सामान्य विज्ञान एवं समसामयिकी)
Part C: Laws & Rules regarding Crimes against Women & Children (महिला एवं बाल अपराध व कानूनी प्रावधान)
Part D: Rajasthan History, Art, Culture, Geography & Economy (राजस्थान का सामान्य ज्ञान, इतिहास, कला व संस्कृति)

subjects.name: Reasoning Ability, Logic & Computer Fundamentals (तार्किक योग्यता एवं कंप्यूटर का सामान्य ज्ञान)
domains: Logical Reasoning & Mental Ability: Analogies, Classification, Coding-Decoding (Letter shift, Number code, Matrix)
Number Series, Alphabet Series & Missing Character in Geometric Figures
Blood Relations, Family Trees & Coded Relationships
Direction and Distance Sense Test (Pythagoras theorem, Compass angles, Shadow problems)
Order & Ranking, Linear & Circular Seating Arrangement, Clock and Calendar
Venn Diagrams, Syllogisms (Statements and Conclusions), Logical Deduction
Non-Verbal Reasoning: Mirror Images, Water Images, Paper Folding, Embedded Figures, Figure Completion
Computer Fundamentals: Computer Generations, Hardware (Input/Output devices, CPU, RAM, ROM, Secondary storage)
Operating Systems: Windows, Linux, Android; File management, GUI, Command Line basics
MS Office Suite: MS Word (Word processing, Shortcuts, Tables), MS Excel (Formulas, Functions, Cell formatting), MS PowerPoint
Internet, Networking & Cyber Security: LAN, WAN, IP addresses, URL, Browsers, Search Engines, Phishing, Antivirus, Firewalls

subjects.name: General Knowledge, General Science & Current Affairs (सामान्य ज्ञान, सामान्य विज्ञान एवं समसामयिकी)
domains: Indian Constitution & Polity: Preamble, Fundamental Rights, Fundamental Duties, Directive Principles of State Policy, Parliament, President, Supreme Court
Indian History: Ancient India (Indus Valley, Vedic Age, Maurya, Gupta), Medieval India (Delhi Sultanate, Mughals), Modern India (Freedom Struggle, 1857 Revolt, INC, Gandhi era)
Indian Geography: Physical divisions of India, Major Rivers, Climate, Soils, Agriculture, National Parks and Wildlife Sanctuaries
General Science - Physics: Newton's laws of motion, Work, Energy, Gravitation, Light, Reflection, Refraction, Lenses, Electricity, Sound
General Science - Chemistry: Matter, Atomic structure, Acids, Bases and Salts, Metals and Non-metals, Chemical reactions, Everyday chemical compounds
General Science - Biology: Cell structure, Human body systems (Circulatory, Digestive, Respiratory, Nervous, Excretory), Genetics, Blood groups
Health, Diseases & Nutrition: Vitamins, Carbohydrates, Proteins, Deficiency diseases, Viral and Bacterial pathogens, Vaccines
National & International Current Affairs, Major Summits, Sports Events (Olympics, Asian Games, IPL), Honors and Awards

subjects.name: Rajasthan History, Art, Culture, Geography & Economy (राजस्थान का इतिहास, कला, संस्कृति, भूगोल एवं अर्थव्यवस्था)
domains: Geography of Rajasthan: Thar Desert, Aravalli mountain range (Guru Shikhar 1722m), Rivers (Chambal, Banas, Luni, Mahi, Banganga), Lakes (Sambhar Salt Lake, Pichola, Fateh Sagar, Nakki Lake)
Climate, Soils, Mineral Wealth (Zinc-Lead at Zawar, Copper at Khetri, Gypsum, Makrana Marble), Forest types & Protected areas

Wildlife Sanctuaries & Tiger Reserves: Ranthambore Tiger Reserve, Sariska, Mukundra Hills, Ramgarh Vishdhari (4th TR), Keoladeo Ghana National Park (UNESCO Bird Sanctuary, Bharatpur), Desert National Park
State Symbols of Rajasthan: State Animal (Chinkara & Camel), State Bird (Godawan / Great Indian Bustard), State Tree (Khejri), State Flower (Rohida), State Dance (Ghoomar), State Sport (Basketball)

History & Brave Dynasties of Rajasthan: Mewar (Maharana Pratap, Haldighati 1576, Rana Kumbha, Rana Sanga, Padmini), Marwar (Rathores, Rao Jodha, Maldeo), Amber/Jaipur (Kachwahas, Sawai Jai Singh II, Jantar Mantar), Chauhans (Prithviraj Chauhan III)
Freedom Movement & 1857 Revolt in Rajasthan: Naseerabad (28 May 1857), Neemuch, Erinpura, Auwa (Thakur Kushal Singh), Prajamandal movements, Peasant movements (Bijolia, Bengu)
Forts & Architecture: UNESCO Hill Forts of Rajasthan (Chittorgarh, Kumbhalgarh - 36km wall, Ranthambore, Gagron, Amer, Jaisalmer / Sonar Qila), Stepwells (Chand Baori Abhaneri), Havelis of Shekhawati

Art & Culture: Folk Deities / Panchpir (Pabuji, Ramdevji, Gogaji, Mehaji, Harbhuji), Tejaji, Karni Mata (Deshnok), Folk Dances (Ghoomar, Kalbelia - UNESCO, Terah Taali, Gair, Chari, Kachhi Ghodi), Fairs (Pushkar, Ramdevra, Baneshwar)
Rajasthan Police Administration: Motto ('सेवार्थ कटिबद्धता' - Committed to Serve), Structure, RAC (Rajasthan Armed Constabulary), Mewar Bhil Corps (MBC), Cyber Crime, Dial 112

subjects.name: Crimes Against Women & Children, Legal Provisions & Protection Acts (महिला एवं बाल अपराध, सुरक्षा नियम व कानूनी प्रावधान)
domains: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO Act, 2012): Definitions, Aggravated sexual assault, Mandatory reporting, Special courts, Child welfare
Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 (घरेलू हिंसा से महिलाओं का संरक्षण अधिनियम): Physical, emotional, sexual, economic abuse, Protection officers, Residence orders
Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013 (POSH Act / विशाखा गाइडलाइन्स): Internal Complaints Committee (ICC), Local Complaints Committee (LCC), Conciliation & Inquiries
Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 (दहेज प्रतिषेध अधिनियम, 1961): Definition of dowry, Penalties for giving/taking dowry, Dowry death under criminal law
Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 (बाल विवाह प्रतिषेध अधिनियम): Legal age of marriage (Male 21, Female 18), Child marriage prohibition officers, Penalties

Criminal Laws & Legal Provisions (IPC / BNS sections): Section 354 (Outraging modesty of women), 354A (Sexual harassment), 354B (Assault to disrobe), 354C (Voyeurism), 354D (Stalking), 376 (Rape), 498A (Cruelty by husband or relatives), 304B (Dowry death)
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 (JJ Act): Child in conflict with law, Child in need of care and protection, Child Welfare Committee (CWC), Juvenile Justice Board (JJB)
Helplines & Government Initiatives: Child Helpline (1098), Women Helpline (1090 / 181), National Cyber Crime Portal (cybercrime.gov.in), Rajasthan Police Suraksha Setu & Garima Helpline
